patch.description: EPIC-17/G04 remains In Progress through admitted V01→V02→V03 and safe merge. Admission: docs/planning/EPIC-17-ADMISSION.md. V01 and V02 are Done; S459 accepts all seven recipes, 73 supported configurations and 146 front/back faces. Woven's 56 local faces pass the approved S457 front mask and local-Y back/band placement. S406's approved view-only collar-over-plackets order remains implemented. V03 is Blocked; no receiver/profile is selected or qualified. CLO 2026.1.310 empirical routes have measured geometry, marks and malformed-input failures; generic OpenCAD R14 is not an industrial apparel profile. The maintainer confirms written product-development/local-DXF permission for the official GetonAgain Free desktop evaluation and authorized installation. The package is installed at C:\Garment CAD(GetonAgain Free version): GMS.exe is V2024.1 and opens to Sign in/Register; no CAD workspace or DXF path is verified. DGS.exe is V2023.1 Pattern Design & Grading and did not expose a targetable window on one launch attempt. No authentication or pattern exchange occurred. The V2024.1 manual documents user-facing modes/options but not DXF entity semantics or standards conformance. Next: maintainer completes sign-in, then verify the local input route and exact contract before opening a source-exact fixture. Preserve V02-before-V03, legacy DXF behavior and protected export identities; preserve all-seven recipes/options/grades, fixed 0.001 cm geometry, identity/seams/marks, malformed-input rejection, repeatability, and rendered-output readability. No ANSI/AAMA or ASTM conformance, physical-fit, factory-acceptance or production-readiness claim. S654 packet: docs/research/epic17/S654-getonagain-installed-build-gate/S654-exit-packet.md.
